verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication SaaS, not an AI coding agent, so restoring an agent session to a prior checkpoint is outside its product category. The evidence shows Basecamp can be used by AI agents through MCP, its CLI and Skills. It shows nothing about Basecamp itself running agent sessions or keeping checkpoint and version history for them.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
